nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Create ecommerce product marketing materials such as selling-point images and A+ style visuals from product images and brief inputs.

aPlusAspectRatio.description: Premium A+ aspect ratio. Supported values: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 1:3.7.

aPlusHasPhone.description: Whether A+ output includes phone display layouts.

aPlusNum.description: Number of standard A+ images, from 0 to 12. Defaults to 0.

aPlusProNum.description: Number of premium A+ images, from 0 to 12. Defaults to 0.

aPlusStyles.description: Optional A+ style entries. Each item may contain a saved style id or a custom prompt.

aspectRatio.description: Target aspect ratio supported by the selected provider.

brandKey.description: Optional brand information serialized as a JSON string. Supported keys: brandColor, fontStyle, salesRegion, language, platform, customSettings.

closeUpTypeNum.description: Number of close-up images, from 0 to 12. Defaults to 0.

closeUpWhiteTypeNum.description: Number of white-background close-up images, from 0 to 12. Defaults to 0.

imageList.description: Public product image URLs. Provide no more than 5 JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WEBP images; each image must be at most 10 MB and between 800 and 4096 pixels.

isExtractPrePoint.description: Whether to automatically extract selling points. Defaults to false. When false, sellerPoint is required.

noText.description: Whether generated images should avoid text.

pointStyles.description: Optional selling-point style entries. Each item may contain a saved style id or a custom prompt.

provider.description: Image model. Defaults to BANANA_2. Supported values: BANANA_2, BANANA_2_LITE, BANANA_PRO, WAN2_7, SEEDREAM5_PRO, GPT_2_IMAGE.

quality.description: GPT Image quality only. Supported values: low, medium, or high.

replaceLibraryId.description: Optional replacement-word library ID used to rewrite generated copy.

resolution.description: Target resolution supported by the selected provider.

sceneTypeNum.description: Number of scene images, from 0 to 12. Defaults to 0.

sellerPoint.description: Product selling points, up to 2500 characters. Required when isExtractPrePoint is false.

sellerTypeNum.description: Number of selling-point images, from 0 to 12. Defaults to 0.

sensitiveLibraryId.description: Optional sensitive-word library ID used to screen generated copy.

whiteBgTypeNum.description: Number of white-background images, from 0 to 12. Defaults to 0.

name: nexscope_ai_product_marketing_image_set_v4
title: AI Product Marketing Image Set API v4
